name: Hentai Seiheki Kyousei Saimin ~Yume no Naka Dake ja Manzoku Dekinai no~
original_name: 変態性癖強制催眠～夢の中だけじゃ満足できないの～
source:
Youichi is always sleeping at school. He is withdrawn and doesn't have friends. His classmates think of him just as "a guy always asleep". But no one knows his dreams are never boring. "Well, you're already wet...." "Mine is better than that girl's.... Come on here, please...." Girls show their naked bodies and immoral personalities in his dream.... "You wanna experience it in the real world?" "What!?" "You are interested in psychology, aren't you? If you want, I'll give you a special power...."

[From ErogeShop]
